Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p

Class FrameCodec

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.FrameCodec
public final class FrameCodec extends Object
Turns a SecureFrame into the transport's length-prefixed, authenticated wire record and back: 
   [int32 body-length][1-byte type][AES-256-GCM ciphertext + 128-bit tag]

The 32-bit big-endian length covers everything after itself (the type byte plus the ciphertext), so a reader can readInt() then read exactly that many bytes - no scanning, no delimiters. The frame type is passed as the GCM additional authenticated data, which cryptographically binds it to the payload: flipping the type byte on the wire makes the tag check fail rather than reclassifying the frame. The per-frame nonce is the caller-supplied counter (see P2pCrypto.counterNonce(long)), so a nonce is never reused under the session key.

Oversize guard. A malicious or corrupt length prefix could otherwise make the reader allocate gigabytes before any tag is checked. checkLength(int) validates the declared body length against MAX_BODY_BYTES (a 4 MiB plaintext cap plus framing) before the buffer is allocated, and encode(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.p2p.SecureFrame, javax.crypto.SecretKey, long) refuses an oversized local payload. All methods are pure and stateless; SecureChannel owns the counters and the socket I/O.

      public static byte[] encode(SecureFrame frame, SecretKey key, long counter) throws GeneralSecurityException
      Seals a frame into a complete wire record ready to write to the socket.
      Parameters:
      frame - the frame to encode (never null)
      key - the direction's AES-256-GCM key
      counter - the per-direction message counter used as the nonce
      Returns:
      the wire bytes [int32 len][type][ciphertext+tag]
      Throws:

    • checkLength

      public static void checkLength(int bodyLength) throws GeneralSecurityException
      Validates a declared body length before the reader allocates its buffer, rejecting anything too small to hold a type+tag or larger than the MAX_BODY_BYTES cap.
      Parameters:
      bodyLength - the int32 length read from the wire
      Throws:
      GeneralSecurityException - if the length is out of the accepted range

    • decode

      public static SecureFrame decode(byte[] body, SecretKey key, long counter) throws GeneralSecurityException
      Opens a wire body (the type byte plus ciphertext, with the length prefix already consumed) back into a SecureFrame.
      Parameters:
      body - the bytes [type][ciphertext+tag]
      key - the direction's AES-256-GCM key
      counter - the per-direction message counter used as the nonce
      Returns:
      the decoded frame, never null
      Throws:
      GeneralSecurityException - if the body is malformed, the type is unknown, or the tag/transcript does not verify (tampering or a desynced counter)
